vulnerability.name: USN-5533-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that Vim incorrectly handled memory access. If a user were tricked into opening a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause the corruption of sensitive information, a crash, or arbitrary code execution.

statements.status_notes: Vim could be made to crash, among other things, if it opened a specially crafted file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
